note: Synthetic English narration made locally with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0). 'text' is what the subtitles show; 'say' is the same sentence spelled for the speech model (names and numbers written out). 'segments' are indices into configs/hackathon/demo_plan.json; a line starts 0.3 s into its first segment and must end before its last one ends. Every number is in submission/claim_ledger.csv.

lines.text: Robot checkpoints are cheap to save but expensive to evaluate, and even an accurate AI judge can be confidently wrong.
lines.say: Robot checkpoints are cheap to save, but expensive to evaluate. And even an accurate AI judge can be confidently wrong.

lines.text: Cosmos-PLV picks which robot checkpoint to test next, and shows when its AI judge can be trusted.
lines.say: Cosmos P L V picks which robot checkpoint to test next, and shows when its AI judge can be trusted.

lines.text: PLV screening, rollouts and NVIDIA Cosmos run on one local GPU; NVIDIA Nemotron runs on Nebius Token Factory.
lines.say: P L V screening, rollouts, and NVIDIA Cosmos run on one local GPU. NVIDIA Nemotron runs on Nebius Token Factory.

lines.text: The dashboard recommends what to test next, beside the free latest-epoch baseline and each rule's measured regret, and warns when strong checkpoints may fool the judge.
lines.say: The dashboard recommends what to test next, beside the free latest epoch baseline and each rule's measured regret, and warns when strong checkpoints may fool the judge.

lines.text: Cheap screening re-runs the original PLV metric script, live, with no rollouts.
lines.say: Cheap screening re-runs the original P L V metric script, live, with no rollouts.

lines.text: Shortlisted checkpoints run in a real robosuite simulation. Cosmos reports, frame by frame, where the can is.
lines.say: Shortlisted checkpoints run in a real robo-suite simulation. Cosmos reports, frame by frame, where the can is.

lines.text: This is a live call to NVIDIA Cosmos3-Edge on the local GPU. It reads eight keyframes, and a fixed rule turns its answers into grasp, drop or success.
lines.say: This is a live call to NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge, on the local GPU. It reads eight key frames, and a fixed rule turns its answers into grasp, drop, or success.

lines.text: Now the same video goes to NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory. The live verdict comes back with its request ID, latency and token count.
lines.say: Now the same video goes to NVIDIA Nemotron, on Nebius Token Factory. The live verdict comes back with its request I D, latency, and token count.

lines.text: The results tab scores both judges against verified simulator outcomes on 330 recorded rollouts.
lines.say: The results tab scores both judges against verified simulator outcomes, on 330 recorded rollouts.

lines.text: Nemotron was right on 96.4% of them, but it still called 9 of 67 failures a success.
lines.say: Nemotron was right on 96 point 4 percent of them. But it still called 9 of 67 failures a success.

lines.text: Exploratory analyses: adaptive allocation, not PLV, cut rollouts two- to threefold; a time limit saved 16% of rollout time.
lines.say: Exploratory analyses: adaptive allocation, not P L V, cut rollouts two to three fold. A time limit saved 16 percent of rollout time.

lines.text: But can we trust the judge? Our pre-registered audits say: not always. The judges could not tell when a replan helped, and they accept failures that end in the goal bin.
lines.say: But can we trust the judge? Our pre-registered audits say: not always. The judges could not tell when a re-plan helped, and they accept failures that end in the goal bin.

lines.text: Here the can is in the wrong compartment. The simulator says failure. Nemotron says it was placed correctly.
lines.say: Here, the can is in the wrong compartment. The simulator says failure. Nemotron says it was placed correctly.

lines.text: It is systematic: Nemotron let 58 of 149 failures into a self-training set, and the resulting policy reached 75% success, versus 86% with plain continued training.
lines.say: It is systematic. Nemotron let 58 of 149 failures into a self-training set, and the resulting policy reached 75 percent success, versus 86 percent with plain continued training.

lines.text: About 7,000 Nebius calls cost an estimated five dollars.
lines.say: About seven thousand Nebius calls cost an estimated five dollars.

lines.text: Faster robot evaluation matters. But before trusting AI-generated labels to train robots, audit what the judge systematically misses.
lines.say: Faster robot evaluation matters. But before trusting AI generated labels to train robots, audit what the judge systematically misses.
